design.bands_definition: b = cycles per 32 samples; x(t) = A cos(2 pi b t / 32 + phi)
design.projection: torch.linalg.lstsq on [cos(2 pi b t/32), sin(2 pi b t/32)]
design.seed_rule: cell rng seed = SEED_BASE + arm offset + cell index
design.truth_note: tone at b lies exactly in span{cos,sin}(b); ||y_b||^2 = K
design.spectrum_note: spec_S_* is the forecast's projected band power ||P_f y||^2 / K at frequency f, in units where a unit-power tone reads 1.0; spec_local is at 1/32-cycle resolution over b +- 1.5
